name: TableDataGateway
summary: One object that carries all the SQL for one table, and hands back results without holding any state about them.

roles.name: TableDataGateway
roles.summary: The single home of every statement touching one table. It is stateless and instance-free of the rows it returns: find, insert, update and delete take and return plain data, which is what distinguishes it from a gateway that wraps a single row.
